channel.title: Kai Xiao Blog
channel.description: Kai Xiao is a CRM, ERP, business systems, and applied AI practitioner sharing the work, ideas, and experiments behind useful digital change.

item.title: Enterprise AI starts with the workflow
item.description: The durable lesson from applied AI cases is simple: define the work, shape the handoffs, and make responsibility visible before asking a model to act.

item.title: AI recruiting works when the whole journey is designed
item.description: A recruiting agent becomes useful when it connects role setup, candidate communication, screening, scheduling, system updates, and human follow-up.

item.title: Finance automation begins with a reliable source table
item.description: The finance cases show why standard fields, clean records, and controlled checks matter more than asking AI to solve an undefined accounting problem.

item.title: AI can move legal teams from review to process management
item.description: The legal case is a reminder that digitization, standardization, first-pass AI, and workflow visibility need to work together.

item.title: A useful AI CRM starts with the customer record
item.description: A lightweight customer workflow can create more value than a complex AI layer when it keeps identity, follow-up, reminders, and context together.

item.title: In manufacturing, trust is part of the model
item.description: An AI inspection system becomes useful when image quality, labeled examples, expert feedback, and visible evidence are designed as one loop.

item.title: Decision support needs a data hub and an escalation path
item.description: The water-management case shows how multiple data sources, domain knowledge, specialist agents, and human review can work together without hiding responsibility.

item.title: Copilot works when the business process is clear
item.description: Copilot and AI agents help most when ownership, data, and operating rules are clear.

item.title: Contact centers are becoming part of CRM
item.description: Service work connects case history, customer profile, knowledge, channels, and follow-up in one flow.

item.title: Power Platform as the business extension layer
item.description: Low-code tools are useful when they sit close to a real business pain, but governance and simple design standards still matter.

item.title: Functional consultants translate between teams
item.description: The value is making translation visible and testable across business, delivery, testing, and leadership.
